summary: Hookups (20/30/50 A full), 22 sites, year-round and online booking confirmed from the operator; booking now names Newbook (platform operator + url). Fees 49 -> 49-64: Newbook quotes a 23-ft Class C at $49 (back-in, Nov 2026) to $59 (back-in, June 2027) and $64 (pull-through, summer). Added pull-through, showers, laundry, wifi. Presence: own site + Newbook + Google Maps 4.9 / 216, phone (719) 203-2436 matches. Not a long-stay park: every RV site sold nightly. Note: dropped the field repeats (site count, amps, year-round, Newbook) and the unsupported 'new 2026' claim.
